title: Lights Out
author: Claude
blurb: A dark cave with no lights at all, because Game-Maker has none. Light is only paint: a block drawn in five brightnesses, laid in rings round a lamp. Level 1 has three lamps that stay where they are. Level 2 is a tunnel where every dark block turns lit when Mia touches it, so they leave light behind them. Level 3 is a hall that starts dark, and a clock lights every block of it in one tick. Signs say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and light a cave of your own.

box.back: A small explorer in a purple beanie goes into a cave with no lights. A lamp is a few blocks painted brighter, in rings. A touch can turn a dark block lit, and a clock can turn a whole hall lit at once. Read the signs, then open the game in Game-Maker and light a cave of your own.
features: Level 1: three lamps and the rings of light round them
Level 2: a dark tunnel that lights where you touch
Level 3: a hall where a clock lights every block at once
Signs in the levels say how it is done
Made to be copied and taken apart
